messages.author: Neha Verma
messages.body:
Dear Amber Team,
I am looking for the AMBER tutorial for QM/MM/MD simulations but can’t able to open it through AMBER website. The tutorial page is not found any more
Not Found
The requested URL /tutorials/advanced/tutorial2/section1.php was not found on this server.
Can you tell me when it will be available again or where can I found the old tutorial if possible.
Best Regards,
Dr. Neha Verma
Bioinformatics Scientist
Enzymaster Deutschland GmbH
Neusser Str. 39
DE-40219 Düsseldorf
Phone: +49-(0)211-158216-10

messages.author: Stephan Schott
messages.body:
Hi Neha,
Had a look, and the links are indeed broken. It seems like the S in section
was mistakenly capitalized. In the meanwhile, change it by hand in the URL
and it should work: *S*ection1.php
Hope it helps,
